messages:
sam: Heads-up — release cut v1.22.0 is blocked, CI build failed during cache restore. Deploy scheduled for 11:00 PT, need decision on whether to wait, rerun, or cut a hotfix.
ci-bot: [automated] Build #4578 failed at step "restore-cache": checksum mismatch for cache key "wheel-cache-v2". Log excerpt: `error: cache archive corrupted (unexpected EOF)`. Pipeline: https://ci.redwood/internal/pipelines/4578
olivia: Looking now. Cache restore returns zero files; fallback to full install makes later artifact indexing time out.
raj: Rerun might pick a different cache key but queue is >10m. Build farm under pressure.
mia: Can we skip cache restore and force a clean build? That adds ~8–12m but is deterministic.
deploy-bot: Deploy paused for release v1.22.0. Policy: failed build => auto-hold. /override requires 2 approvals from release leads.
sam: Options: hold and fix CI, or populate cache and rerun. If corruption is widespread, better to fix infra. If localized, repopulate cache.
olivia: Root cause likely partial S3 object from a failed previous upload. I'll open infra ticket. Quick workaround: prepopulate cache with a healthy artifact.
raj: I can run a `ci:cache-populate` job on a warmed node to rebuild the wheel cache. ETA ~8m.
mia: PMs want release notes out today; if this adds <15m we wait, otherwise we shift the window.
sam: Raj, go ahead. Olivia, monitor S3 and loop in eng-infra if upload errors persist. If this still fails, postpone the cut by +2h and notify PM.
raj: Started cache-populate job (job id: 8991). Logs: "upload complete, keys: wheel-cache-v2-20250401". Rerunning build now.
ci-bot: Build #4580 queued -> restore step passed, but failed at "artifact-indexer": `IndexError: index version mismatch (expected v3, got v2)`\nstack: indexer.py:212 -> validate_index()
olivia: Hmm — indexer expecting v3, but the wheel-builder on some nodes produced v2. Toolchain mismatch between builder images.
mia: Can indexer be made backward-compatible quickly? Risky to change production behavior now.
raj: Quick mitigation: pin the wheel-builder image to the tag that produces v3 (image: `wheel-builder:v3.2.1`) for this job. Re-running with that.
ci-bot: Build #4581 passed all stages. Artifacts uploaded to s3://redwood-artifacts/prod/v1.22.0/
sam: Great. Two approvals needed to proceed. @olivia @mia pls approve so deploy can continue. :thumbsup:
olivia: +1 — verified artifact index v3 and checksums OK (sha256:abc123...)
mia: +1. Release notes checked, no further blockers.
deploy-bot: /deploy v1.22.0 -> scheduled. Canary 10% for 10m, automatic promote if healthy.
sam: Canary rolling now, monitoring errors/latency.
deploy-bot: Canary promote started -> canary nodes healthy, no error spikes.
ci-bot: Post-deploy smoke tests: all green :white_check_mark:
sam: Thanks all. Follow-ups: ENG-INFRA to add write-after-confirmation on cache uploads and CI to validate index format early. @olivia please file tickets.
olivia: Created INF-2413 (S3 upload consistency) and CI-8732 (index-format gating). Linking both: https://jira.redwood/browse/INF-2413, https://jira.redwood/browse/CI-8732
sam: Closing thread — update if regressions appear.
